# FrugalDomain

> Free browser-based tools for designers and developers, in English, Arabic, Hindi, Simplified Chinese and Turkish.
> Icons, image/audio/document conversion, a vector editor and whiteboard,
> a form builder, a learning center and Shopify themes and apps.

Everything below runs in the visitor's browser unless the page says otherwise:
nothing is uploaded, there is no account, no quota and no trial period. Arabic
is a first-class language here rather than a translation layer — the Arabic
pages carry their own copy and the tools handle Arabic text deliberately.

The developer tools and the component library moved to https://frugaldomain.online/en/tools/.

## Converters and editors

- [Image converter](https://frugaldomain.site/ImageConvert): Convert between PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF and more, locally.
- [Audio converter](https://frugaldomain.site/AudioConvert): MP3, WAV, OGG and AAC, via FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly.
- [Document converter](https://frugaldomain.site/FileConvert): DOCX and XLSX to PDF, including Arabic text that most converters mangle.
- [Vector editor](https://frugaldomain.site/vector-editor): Draw, clip, combine and export vector artwork.
- [Drawing board](https://frugaldomain.site/Drower/Board): The editor itself, with around three hundred editable templates.
- [Touch simulator](https://frugaldomain.site/Drower/TouchSimulator): Handwriting and gesture data collection.

## Single-conversion pages

- [PNG to JPG](https://frugaldomain.site/convert/png-to-jpg)
- [WebP to PNG](https://frugaldomain.site/convert/webp-to-png)
- [JPG to WebP](https://frugaldomain.site/convert/jpg-to-webp)
- [PNG to GIF](https://frugaldomain.site/convert/png-to-gif)

## Shopify store management

- [Shopify store management](https://frugaldomain.site/shopify): Connect a Shopify store and manage products, orders, customers, inventory and content in one workspace. Real-time two-way sync (verified webhooks in, a retrying queue out), team roles and permissions, free. Also at /ar/shopify, /hi/shopify, /zh/shopify and /tr/shopify.

## Libraries

- [Icon library](https://frugaldomain.site/IconsGalary): Hundreds of icons in SVG and PNG, served over a CDN or copied out as JSX.
- [Apps gallery](https://frugaldomain.site/apps): Applications published on FrugalDomain, each with docs and a live browser demo.

## Arabic site

The Arabic pages are not machine translations; each carries its own copy and
routes into the shared tool at its English URL.

- [الصفحة الرئيسية](https://frugaldomain.site/ar)
- [مكتبة الأيقونات](https://frugaldomain.site/ar/IconsGalary)
- [تحويل الصور](https://frugaldomain.site/ar/ImageConvert)
- [تحويل الصوت](https://frugaldomain.site/ar/AudioConvert)
- [تحويل الملفات](https://frugaldomain.site/ar/FileConvert)
- [محرر الرسوم المتجهة](https://frugaldomain.site/ar/vector-editor)
- [الأسئلة الشائعة](https://frugaldomain.site/ar/Faq)

## Hindi, Chinese and Turkish

Every public page is also published in Hindi, Simplified Chinese and Turkish,
at /hi, /zh and /tr followed by the English path (/hi/learn,
/zh/ImageConvert, /tr/Drower/Board), each with its own translated copy, FAQ
and structured data.

- [हिन्दी](https://frugaldomain.site/hi) · [इमेज कन्वर्टर](https://frugaldomain.site/hi/ImageConvert) · [आइकन](https://frugaldomain.site/hi/IconsGalary)
- [中文](https://frugaldomain.site/zh) · [图片转换器](https://frugaldomain.site/zh/ImageConvert) · [图标库](https://frugaldomain.site/zh/IconsGalary)
- [Türkçe](https://frugaldomain.site/tr) · [Görsel dönüştürücü](https://frugaldomain.site/tr/ImageConvert) · [Simgeler](https://frugaldomain.site/tr/IconsGalary)
